# DESK COMMENTARY — 2026-10-06 PT

## Overnight / Macro
- **S&P 500 +0.58%, Nasdaq flat near records** — breadth best since early August; small caps lagged (R2K −0.59%).
- **10-year Treasury yield holding above 5.3%** — Bessent rhetoric attempts to cap upside; energy rallies (WTI $89.44, Nat Gas +1.6%) support inflation narrative.

## Cross-asset / Politics
- **Defense tailwind: Anduril $3.7B Maryland shipyard** investment backed by $2.9B Navy contract signals continued mil-industrial support.
- **Senate control fight heating** — Maine debate highlights spending risk; monitor policy uncertainty for rate/fiscal outlook.

## Sector & Tickers
- **Comms Equipment +4.5% led Tech** — CIEN +13.9% on AI switch demand; IT Index +0.5%.
- **Staples XLP +0.9% outperforms** — LW +7.5% post-earnings beat/raise; CPG resilience.
- **Apple smart-home ecosystem** expansion (doorbell, lock, thermostat w/ LG codevelop) broadens Services TAM.
- **Wells Fargo maintains GOOGL Overweight** — stable positioning into earnings season.

## Put-Seller Takeaway
- **Lean in on defined short calls** — sticky rallies, record highs, and +0.6% breadth favor premium capture; avoid size in small caps.
- **Watch IV decay into NFLX (10/20), ALOY (10/14)** — earnings volatility may spike; theta favorable until then.
